scope: Full F09 implementation, independent reference and 34 authored tests; full legacy bars and source tape; direct caller passages previously read and checked against this change. New verify/ports integration fully read.

findings.finding: Forming missing and final missing witnesses reuse the same bar/target/end identity with distinct versions. The intentional immutable opportunity conflict gate therefore raises before the intended eligible-count assertion.
findings.repair: Use distinct declared target definitions for the two separate denominator exclusion examples, and separately assert version substitution conflict for one opportunity. Keep the fixed expected eligible1/success0.

findings.finding: Even after filtering prefix_id to eligible inputs (I08), semantic version_id includes the admission cursor. An unavailable future admission suffix therefore still changes a reconstructed old-cut semantic version.
findings.repair: Retain cursor as audit/replay evidence while computing semantic version from eligible prefix identity and publication semantics. Compare freshly reconstructed identical old cuts with and without future additions and future corrections; retain the distinct same-cut later-admission behavior.

findings.finding: Legacy BarEngine and ActivityBars configuration and public collections remain assignable/mutable.
findings.repair: Freeze configuration and expose immutable views of retained publications/state while preserving BarEngine.ledger.correct access and narrow legacy callers.

findings.finding: Legacy BarEngine restore trusts plausible serialized price/volume outputs without publication input/coverage/watermark/prefix reconstruction.
findings.repair: Retain each admitted request and its actual ledger prefix, verify it is retained in the final ledger history and reconstruct every publication including prior same-cut cursors; enforce bounded publication retention.

findings.finding: Legacy ActivityBars restore does not reconstruct first threshold crossing and interleaved same-known-time resets; output close_reason and threshold flags can be forged.
findings.repair: Retain an ordered add/boundary operation journal and replay it; compare every completed/forming/output frontier field and exact canonical representation.

findings.finding: Legacy activity admission repeatedly sums all pending event quantities, creating quadratic work for high thresholds.
findings.repair: Use an exact pending-volume counter and reconstruct it through the retained operation journal; retain the old literal path as the bounded baseline, with no unsupported universal speedup claim.

linked_repair_details.F09-I01: Canonical sort imported rows by market key for rows_hash and validate every before/after correction endpoint against the imported domain/interval; bound changes and reject malformed no-publication checkpoints.
linked_repair_details.F09-I02/I06/I14: Store capture event timestamp and block IDs/index once; verify factory ownership/cursor without recursive prefix rehash on each query; retain all construction/hash/lineage copying counters separately; materialize mixed activity definitions under one outer event dispatch and enforce aggregate bounds atomically.
linked_repair_details.F09-I03: Unknown anchored CVD propagates as None after unknown mass until an explicit reset, without making otherwise valid whole-event partitions unavailable.
linked_repair_details.F09-I04/I09/I10: Typed immutable output validation plus factory-certified shared publications prevent dataclass replacement from claiming finality; actual two-right-final fixture needs two distinct compatible ordered final bars.
linked_repair_details.F09-I13: Compare complete forming and completed supported metadata, corrections/reset lineage, bounds, import tamper, activity checkpoint and suffix cases; preserve protocol/golden bytes.
